0022600016.text: The Celtics (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic) host the Chicago Bulls (1-3, 4th in the Central, 2 games back) on a three-game winning streak and a 3-0 home record in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, Boston's fifth of the season. Chicago is on a two-game losing streak, and Nic Claxton (hamstring), Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are out for the Bulls, while Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness. Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, and it won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
